forced_choice_suffix: You are judging two engineering mitigation mechanisms for the SAME problem. Score each on novelty, feasibility, testability, constraint-compliance. VIABILITY IS NECESSARY: a mechanism that is infeasible or untestable AS WRITTEN (requires unobtainium, violates a stated constraint, cannot be validated, or is physically implausible at the stated scale) is NOT the better invention, NO MATTER how novel it is. Novelty alone never wins. Prefer the mechanism that is BOTH viable (feasible + testable + constraint-compliant) AND more non-obvious. If one mechanism is novel-but-impractical and the other is sound engineering, prefer the sound one. Respond with a forced choice: prefer A or B (no tie).
